usedFor: Guests and events from Evenium reach LeadConnector as contacts, tags or workflow entries, starting from “New Guests Added”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Guests Added” in Evenium, then “Create Or Update Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: Each new guest becomes a LeadConnector contact, and an existing contact is updated instead of repeated.

watchOut: Evenium triggers are polling, and “Guest Created or Updated” fires on edits, so a guest can arrive late or twice.
